description: Election Commission  - Declare that  A. Sivakumaran and L. Saththiyamoorthi as memners of the Karachchi P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government authority (Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including resignation of members, nomination by political parties, and declaration of elected members to fill vacancies. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters at the local government level.
